'''Bomberhead '''is one of the [[Jaquio]]'s servants, and the Vice-Leader of the Malice Four. Born in the rough streets of the South Bronx, Bomberhead had a brutal childhood. This traumatizing experience led him to a life of crime and injustice. As the years passed, he grew more and more feared until he gained his rightful place as '''New York's Lord of Evil.''' Recently he's been on hiatus from this job, acting as one of the Jaquio's servants.

==''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]''==
Bomberhead is the boss of Act 2, and [[Ryu Hayabusa|Ryu]] encounters him in [[Amura's Altar]]. Bomberhead has an identical pattern to [[The Barbarian|the Barbarian]] before him, walking forward slowly and stopping to attack. The main differences is that Bomberhead's weapon of choice is a spinning chain and sickle (which covers a greater range), and he walks forward for longer than Barbarian does. However, Ryu can duck under Bomberhead's sickle swing to avoid it, even though it'll be clipping through his head. The sickle can also be destroyed if it's attacked enough (best done with sub-weapons), leaving Bomberhead with no weapon.

Bomberhead's sickle does 1 damage, but his contact does 2 damage. His biggest weakness is the [[Jump & Slash Technique]]: Ryu simply has to jump over him and close to him to defeat him in just two hits.
